name: BrainX Lab
tagline: Brain–computer interfaces, EEG signal processing and affective computing.
about: BrainX Lab is the research group led by Dr. Kannadasan K in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM) Kancheepuram. We build intelligent systems that read brain and physiological signals to understand human cognition, emotion and health — spanning brain–computer interfaces, EEG signal processing, affective computing and machine learning, with applications in emotion, imagined speech, immersive VR and biofeedback-based mental health.
focus: Brain–Computer Interfaces, EEG Signal Processing, Affective Computing, Machine Learning
address: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM) Kancheepuram, Chennai
